WITH DateRange AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_SUB(CAST('2026-02-23' AS DATE), INTERVAL 12 MONTH) AS start_date,
    CAST('2026-02-23' AS DATE) AS end_date
), EntryZones AS (
  SELECT
    entry_zone AS zone,
    COUNT(*) AS entry_count
  FROM estishraf_llm_border_crossings_impala
  WHERE
    entry_date BETWEEN (
      SELECT
        start_date
      FROM DateRange
    ) AND (
      SELECT
        end_date
      FROM DateRange
    )
  GROUP BY
    entry_zone
), ExitZones AS (
  SELECT
    exit_zone AS zone,
    COUNT(*) AS exit_count
  FROM estishraf_llm_border_crossings_impala
  WHERE
    exit_date BETWEEN (
      SELECT
        start_date
      FROM DateRange
    ) AND (
      SELECT
        end_date
      FROM DateRange
    )
  GROUP BY
    exit_zone
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(e.zone, x.zone) AS zone,
  COALESCE(e.entry_count, 0) AS entry_count,
  COALESCE(x.exit_count, 0) AS exit_count
FROM EntryZones AS e
FULL OUTER JOIN ExitZones AS x
  ON e.zone = x.zone
ORDER BY
  (
    COALESCE(e.entry_count, 0) + COALESCE(x.exit_count, 0)
  ) DESC
LIMIT 20000
